blocks.html: 44ft Premium Flybridge – Private Fishing Charter in San José del Cabo

The 44ft Premium Flybridge is one of the largest private fishing charter options offered by Exotic Fish Cabo, accommodating groups of up to 10 guests. Departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, this spacious vessel is an excellent choice for families, groups of friends, and anglers seeking additional comfort during an offshore fishing adventure.

Its defining feature is the elevated flybridge, which provides a higher vantage point for observing the ocean and spotting surface activity. Below, the generous fishing deck offers room for anglers to move around, while the sheltered cabin, comfortable seating, and onboard bathroom provide convenient spaces to relax between fishing sessions.

The 44-foot layout makes this charter particularly appealing to larger private groups who want to combine sportfishing with a comfortable day on the water.

Depending on the season and ocean conditions, fishing opportunities may include yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo, and marlin. The crew selects suitable fishing areas based on weather, currents, and recent fish activity.

Fishing equipment, bottled water, and soft drinks are included. Additional services and any extra charges are confirmed before booking.

Private fishing charter for 1–10 guests. Contact Exotic Fish Cabo for current pricing and availability.
